# Will your coworking or flex-office space break even, and how much cash does the ramp-up eat?

> Free coworking space profit calculator: floor area, offices, desks, memberships, rent and staff become monthly profit, break-even occupancy, the cash reserve for ramp-up, loan coverage and payback. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
